name: docs-page-layout
title: Docs page layout
description: A three-column documentation page: your sidebar, the article with breadcrumbs and meta, and an on-this-page rail that tracks your place.
docs: Give every heading in children an id that matches an entry in toc. Plain h2, h3, p, ul, ol, pre and table elements are styled for you; long URLs and keys break instead of widening a phone, and a table wider than the screen scrolls on its own (give it tabIndex={0}). Below xl the rail becomes a disclosure; below lg put the sidebar in your own mobile menu. Set --sticky-top to your header's height.
